create_seed_oss_config: create a SeedOssConfig instance with custom model hyperparameters for initialization
initialize_seed_oss_model: initialize a SeedOssModel from a SeedOssConfig configuration object
configure_attention_heads: configure SeedOssConfig with custom num_attention_heads and num_key_value_heads for GQA
set_rope_parameters: set rope_parameters on SeedOssConfig for rotary embedding configuration
customize_seed_oss_hyperparameters: customize SeedOssConfig hyperparameters like hidden_size, intermediate_size, and max_position_embeddings
